basis: Progressive brain disease with dystonia, parkinsonism and pyramidal dysfunction; damaging ocular findings occur in only 1-4%.
Congenital cerebral calcification, microcephaly, seizures and developmental impairment; resembles infection but has no established infectious cause.
Benign microfollicular neoplasm arising in the thyroid gland.
Carcinoma arising in the parotid salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Familial primary myelofibrosis affects marrow and blood; hepatic extramedullary hematopoietic infiltration occurs in roughly 40% of primary myelofibrosis.
Localized abnormal dilation of lip veins; vascular disease without evidence of separate oral mucosal damage.
Defined by skeletal muscle paralysis and distal motor neuropathy; mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder is an explicit parent.
Anaplastic sarcoma arising in the kidney.
Severe congenital skeletal myopathy; respiratory failure and dysphagia reflect muscle weakness without demonstrated intrinsic lung or gastrointestinal injury.
Primary bronchopulmonary adenocarcinoma arising in lung tissue.
Infection with dysregulated host response and organ dysfunction; direct acute kidney injury occurs in approximately 40-50%; other organ injury varies.
Disease defined by dysfunction of the cardiac electrical conduction system.
Joint hypermobility and skin hyperextensibility/fragility define the group; severe vascular or ocular disease is subtype-specific.
Carcinoma arising within the thyroid gland; thymic differentiation does not establish immune disease.
CAD pyrimidine synthesis disorder with developmental epileptic encephalopathy and characteristic anemia; renal tubular acidosis in one reported patient cannot establish prevalence.
Defined as inherited metabolic diseases causing CNS myelin abnormalities; peripheral nerve damage shares the neurologic axis; other organs vary by subtype.
Defining combination of cone-rod retinal dystrophy and amelogenesis imperfecta; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Myeloid leukemia with coagulation dysfunction; direct cutaneous leukemic infiltration occurs in roughly 30-40%; common damaging hepatic involvement is less certain.
Defined by bifid nose, anorectal defects and renal malformations; renal agenesis in 6/9. Isolated small-denominator cardiac findings do not establish common involvement.
Autoimmune brain-retina-inner ear microangiopathy; damaging hearing loss is a diagnostic criterion and occurs in 30-79%. Cardiovascular axis omitted under four-axis cap.
Schwannomas and meningiomas define disease; hearing loss in 30-79%, cataracts in ~55%, cutaneous schwannomas in ~60%. Pigment spots alone do not qualify.
Adenocarcinoma of paratesticular reproductive tissues; no covered organ or qualifying mechanism axis.
Hereditary macular dystrophy; both retinal and corneal ancestry fall within the ocular axis.
RNF213-associated cerebral arterial occlusive disease; supplied transient ischemic attacks do not establish lasting brain damage in at least 30%.
Defined by progressive nephropathy, sensorineural hearing loss and characteristic ocular abnormalities; lenticonus is a major diagnostic feature despite uncommon vision loss.
